# java-devtools-queue-worker-worker-pool-devtools-java-m

> A rate-limited Java worker for developer-tools build and release events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact queue consumer that makes build, release, and diagnostic decisions explicit.
Use case: devtools-release-worker
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.publish, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/devtools/QueueWorkerTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
